result.title: EGI-BENCH: An Enterprise General Intelligence Benchmark Suite
result.summary: Enterprise adoption of LLMs in agentic workflows is gated by evaluations that span a wide arc of abilities: CRM operations, heterogeneous-document retrieval, personal data understanding, multi-turn planning, tool use, function calling, long-horizon research, and long-context software engineering. These evaluations live today in separate repositories with divergent runners, dependencies, and scoring conventions, which makes cross-benchmark comparison difficult and obscures what a single aggregate number actually represents. We release EGI-BENCH, a unified LLM agent benchmark suite that consolidates eight enterprise facing agent benchmarks (CRMARENA, HERB, PERSONABENCH, USERBENCH, MCP-UNIVERSE, MCPEVAL, BENCHFORCE, LOCOBENCH) behind a single command-line interface with two runtime-budgeted execution modes. On top of the suite we define the Enterprise General Intelligence (EGI) Score, a six-dimensional framework (M1-M6) whose buckets are populated by fine-grained sub-metrics routed from each benchmark rather than by benchmark-level averages. We describe the suite, the sub-metric routing, and the quick/deep budgets, and report results for fourteen frontier and cost-efficient LLMs spanning the GPT, Claude, and Gemini families under quick mode. Top-line EGI ranges from 39.6 (GPT-4o mini) to 65.6 (gpt-5.5), and no single model dominates every capability axis: gpt-5.5 leads task outcome, planning, and retrieval grounding; Claude Sonnet 4.5 leads tool actioning and safety/abstention; and Claude Haiku 4.5 leads engineering quality. Code is available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/egi-bench.

AI.brief_summary: 该文发布 EGI-BENCH，将八个面向企业场景的 LLM agent 基准整合到统一命令行接口与 quick/deep 两种运行预算下，并定义由细粒度子指标路由填充的六维 EGI 评分，报告十四款前沿模型在 quick 模式下的结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属纯文本企业 agent 评测整合，与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系；但其「子指标路由替代基准级平均」的聚合设计、分档计算预算以及包含弃答/安全轴的评价维度，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本测量与停止决策评价提供参照，需核查是否可迁移。
